# Step 2.65: correcting a tracked game in the grid

## Layer 1 (builder one): below the screen

What exists, in `packages/core/src/modules/games` (all exported from its `index.ts`):

- `apply-plays.ts`, `applyPlays(...)`: the one door. The body of `games.apply_tracker_commands` that applies commands with the engine and saves events, state, lines and score, moved out unchanged; the tracker's batches and the grid both go through it.
- `grid-correction-plays.ts`, `gridCorrectionPlays(teams, replayedLines, wantedLines)`: pure. Gives `{ ok: true, plays }` (take-backs first, then fouls and turnovers, then baskets) or `{ ok: false, problems }` (`team-not-in-game`, `player-listed-twice`, `basket-taken-back`).
- `commands/read-tracked-box-score.ts`, `readTrackedBoxScore({ gameId })`, permission `games.correct`: `{ gameId, sequence, correctable, notCorrectable?, lines: TrackedGridRow[] }`, a row per player of the game's day (`teamId, personId, jerseyNumber, secondsPlayed, points, fg1, fg2, fg3, fouls, turnovers`).
- `commands/correct-tracked-box-score.ts`, `correctTrackedBoxScore({ gameId, sequence, lines })`, permission `games.correct`; a line is `trackedGridLine`: `teamId, personId` and any of `fg1, fg2, fg3, fouls, turnovers` (left out stays). Gives `{ sequence, plays }`. Refusals (`CorrectTrackedBoxScoreError`): `game-not-found`, `not-allowed`, `not-tracked`, `game-final` (reopen first), `game-not-live`, `reason-needed` (live but not reopened), `changed-since-read` (pass the read's `sequence`), `team-not-in-game`, `player-listed-twice`, `player-not-on-team`, `statistic-not-kept`, `rule` with `problem: 'basket-taken-back'` or `problem: 'engine'` (the engine's own words).
- Registered in `packages/core/src/commands.ts`; activity words `activity.games.correct_tracked_box_score` and `activityNamed...` in `packages/site/src/messages/en/activity.ts`; the read listed in `apps/web/src/server/activity-messages.test.ts`; two rows each in `role-matrix.test.ts`; isolation cases in `packages/database/src/isolation/grid-correction-cases.test-helper.ts`. Decision T-405 (pending file), spec T6 §8 corrected. No migration.

Run and passed: games folder of core (530, before the read test), `grid-correction-plays.test.ts` (5), `read-tracked-box-score.test.ts` (2), `correct-tracked-box-score.test.ts` (5: the foul moved is `unfoul` then `foul` in the log and the replay gives the grid), role matrix with activity messages (272), isolation folder (389), `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`, typecheck, `npm run check`. Broken by hand once each: the order of plays (2 failed), the `changed-since-read` check together with the side of a team (3 failed), the open-reopen check of the read (1 failed).

What is left. Layer 2: the screen in `apps/web/src/app/[league]/admin/games` (an "Edit box score" for a tracked game, reading `readTrackedBoxScore`, offered only when `correctable`, otherwise a link to reopen; the save sends `sequence` back; words for every refusal in a message file). Layer 3: the browser test and the pinned lists (page-step rows, harmful-text test, `nothing-unfinished`).

What I distrust:

- A basket cannot be lowered or moved (T-405): the engine has no take-back of an earlier basket. If the founder wants it, `packages/sports` needs an "unscore" command, which the build plan does not allow yet.
- The admin's plays bump the game's events while a scorekeeper's device may still hold the session; that device learns of them only on its next refusal or reload (T-113).
- `isolation` and the matrix only cover a save with no lines; the writes themselves are covered in core's memory stores, not against PostgreSQL.

## Layer 2 (builder two): the screen

What exists, in `apps/web/src/features/games-area` (route `app/[league]/admin/games/[game]/edit/page.tsx`):

- `tracked-grid-page.tsx`, `TrackedGridPage`: 404 unless `readTrackedBoxScore` answers; not correctable, it says why (`admin.boxScore.tracked.notCorrectable.*`) with the way back to the game's page, where the reopen form is. Correctable: the grid (MIN and PTS shown, FTM, 2PM, 3PM, PF and TO when kept typed), the sentence that baskets only go up with the link to the scoring screen (`leagueUrl(…, 'score')`), and after a save, once, one sentence per play (notice screen `tracked-grid`, the plays as marks in `about`).
- `box-score-page.tsx`: for a tracked game and someone who may correct it, the button "Edit the box score" when correctable, else the same "what to do first" sentence.
- `tracked-grid.ts` (pure: field names, columns, form to `WantedLine`s, a lowered basket refused before sending, play marks to sentence keys); `run-tracked-grid-action.ts` (read, sequence compared, the plays worked out with core's `gridCorrectionPlays`, the command, refusals mapped to a box); `correctTrackedGridAction` in `actions.ts`; `tracked-grid-form.tsx` (client; the typed values kept, the sentence beside the first wrong box or at the top with "Load it again"). A refusal does not draw the page again (so a stale grid never gets the new sequence). Words: `admin.boxScore.tracked.*` in `messages/en/admin-games.ts`. Decision T-406 (pending), spec T6 §8 corrected.
- Pinned lists: two page-step rows in `check-web-shell.mjs` (the edit page of another league's game and of an untracked game: 404); `harmful-text-test.mjs` opens the route and names the grid's boxes in NOT_COVERED. No new command or read, so no role-matrix or activity row. No migration.

Run and passed: `tracked-grid.test.ts` (6: a foul moved is `unfoul` then `foul` and the re-read gives the lines; stale, lowered basket and bad box refused; closed while not reopened; the form keeps typed values beside the box and at the top; every word exists), games-area and `packages/site` folders (178), `npm run test:web` (290), typecheck, `npm run check`, pending decisions (11). Broken by hand once each: the plays dropped from the answer (1 failed), the typed values replaced by the saved ones (2 failed), the take-back's sentence key (1 failed).

What is left for layer 3: the browser test (a game tracked in the browser, ended, reopened with a reason, a foul moved to the right player in the grid; the event log shows `unfoul` and `foul`; the public page shows the same lines; a lowered basket refused beside its box; the sentences after the save), typing the harmful text into the grid's boxes (then take them out of NOT_COVERED), and the whole chain. The harmful-text test was not run here (it builds the app).

What I distrust:

- The correctable page itself was never drawn by a real server: the stand-in has no tracked game with a saved state (its game 2 answers `not-tracked`), so only the 404s are page-checked. Layer 3 must open it.
- Reopening a tracked game from its page sends the admin to the games list (`then: 'games'`, as before), not back to the game, where "Edit the box score" now is: one more tap. Not changed here.
- The sentences come from the plays worked out before the command runs, from the same read; the command checked the sequence, so they are the same plays, but they are not read back from the log.
- The tracked game's page still says "Correct it in the tracker" under its title (`admin.boxScore.locked.tracked`), true but no longer the only way.

## Layer 3 (builder three): in a real server

What exists:

- `tests/browser/tracked-grid-test.mjs` (27 checks, builds the app): a scorekeeper tracks a few plays on the scoring screen (a foul tapped on number 7 that was number 9's) and ends the game; before reopening, the game's page and `/edit` say "reopen it with a reason first" and draw no grid, and the page names both ways to correct it; the owner reopens with a reason and lands on the game's page ("live again", "Edit the box score"); a scorekeeper's device opens the game and holds it; in the grid the foul is moved and saved: two plain sentences, take-back first; `/state` ends `unfoul` (7) then `foul` (9); the device's next tap is saved on top, the correction stands on the server and the device then shows the corrected fouls and its own basket; a lowered 3-pointer is refused beside its box, every box kept, nothing saved; a grid left open while a second tab saved is refused at the top with "Load it again", the box kept, nothing saved, and loaded again it shows the second tab's change alone; ended again on a device, the public game page's box score has exactly the grid's home lines. Every wait has a limit.
- The lead's decisions, written as U-20 (pending, "Decided for you"), spec T6 §8 corrected: reopening a tracked game that this person may edit in its grid sends them back to the game's page (`box-score-page.tsx`, the form's `then` left out when `trackedGrid` is read), which says `admin.boxScore.done.reopenTracked`; `admin.boxScore.locked.tracked` now names the grid and the scoring screen. A scorekeeper who may not edit the grid still lands on the games list, as before. `games-area-test.mjs` now pins the admin's landing on the game's page with the new sentence, the grid's link and no score boxes; its scorekeeper half and `after-midnight-test` (a scorekeeper) are unchanged.
- `harmful-text-test.mjs`: a last step (`walkTheTrackedGrid`) plays the live game to its end from a tablet (taking it over), reopens it with the attack as the reason, types the attack into every grid box and saves: refused by name, every box still holds the attack as text, no script ran, no element made. The NOT_COVERED line is gone.

Product faults found in the page: none beyond the landing above. The device check (item 4) found no overwrite: the server applies the device's tap on its own state, and the device rebuilt on the server's state after it.

Run and passed: `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:web` (290), `npm run format:check`, games-area and `packages/site` vitest (172), `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` (11); browser: `tracked-grid-test`, `games-area-test` (38), `after-midnight-test` (5), `needs-result-test` (33) in one chunk; `harmful-text-test` (2270). Broken by hand once: the reopen's landing put back to the games list (tracked-grid-test: 5 failed). The harmful step was not broken by hand.

What is left: the whole browser chain was not run (I am not the last helper).

What I distrust:

- `admin.boxScore.locked.tracked` is the page's subtitle for everyone who opens a tracked game's page, so a scorekeeper who may not use the grid also reads about "Edit the box score".
- The game is still ended only on the scoring screen after a grid correction; the grid page offers no "end it again".
- The harmful step leaves the game held by its tablet (it is the last step; nothing after it scores).

## Review (independent reviewer)

Item 1, the move (b47315c7): faithful. The body lines of `apply-plays.ts` are the old ones word for word (compared with `git show` and `diff`); ids, the duplicate check, the lock, `seq`, the refusals and the one transaction stay in `apply-tracker-commands.ts`, and `seq = applied.seq` comes before the answer is written down, as before. Passed: core games folder (532), the database tracker files (`tracker-commands`, `tracked-game-end-commands`, `table-players-commands`, `scorekeeper-reopen-commands`: 30), browser `tracker-offline-test` (17) and `tracked-grid-test` (27) in one chunk.

Item 2, attacks (a throwaway test, not committed): stale `sequence` and the same save posted twice (second `changed-since-read`, no plays added twice), ended and not reopened, or ended again on the tablet after the reopen (`game-final`), a scorekeeper (`not-allowed`), -1, 1.5 and 1000 (`invalid-input`), the other team's player, an unknown person, another game's team (refused by name): all refused, nothing written. A 12-play save: the replayed log gives exactly the saved state (`derive` equal: lines, team fouls, bonus, minutes unchanged). Item 3: the owner can end the game again (on the scoring screen, End game); the public page then reads Final, Corrected, with the grid's lines, and standings answer (not compared before and after).

- Medium. A scorekeeper's Undo on the scoring screen walks back into the admin's correction: after a grid save, a tablet tap and two Undos, the second Undo took back the admin's foul (tablet `undo` after `correct-tracked-box-score`, as in the throwaway test). Nothing stops or tells it; the log still explains it, but the correction is silently half undone, and the end of a correction happens on that very screen. Name it on the scoring screen, or decide (T-405) that Undo stops at a correction.
- Medium. What the admin must do today to finish: save the grid, tap "Open the scoring screen", open the game there (taking it from any device that holds it), tap End game. The grid page has no "end it again", and a corrected game left live is out of the standings until someone does this. The words (`admin-games.ts` line 15) say so; a button on the grid page, or an end in the same save, would close the gap.
- Low. Every grid play lands in the period and clock time the game ended in (`correct-tracked-box-score.ts` line 159, `at: now`; the engine takes the current period): a foul moved from period 1 counts toward the last period's team fouls and bonus (7 period fouls, penalty, in the test), and the public play by play shows the corrected plays at the last period's time.
- Low, test gap. The check of a statistic the season does not keep before anything is written (`correct-tracked-box-score.ts` lines 140 to 143) is tested by nothing: broken by hand, the 11 tests of `correct-tracked-box-score.test.ts` and `tracked-grid.test.ts` still passed; without it a direct call with turnovers in a standard season throws (a server error) instead of `statistic-not-kept`. Restored.
- Low. A grid save has no limit on plays: 200 lines with 999 in each box is one transaction of up to a million events; a typo (30 for 3) adds 27 baskets that only Undo on the scoring screen takes back, one by one, from the newest.

Item 4: no wait without a limit, no check passing on a timeout or behind a `.catch` in the lane's tests (the device loop in `tracked-grid-test.mjs` near line 361 has a limit and a check after it). No migration is needed.
